rec.name: Cart Free Gift (Goodie) Row with Progress Bar and Variant Selector
rec.status: Backlog — reference from Smilodox; exact logic still unclarified

what.text: A new section in the cart (drawer) that shows a free gift ("goodie") as its own highlighted row above the regular line items. The reference screenshot shows a steel water bottle 2.2L with its original price struck through (29.99 €), a green progress bar, a "GRATIS" (free) label with a check icon, a size/variant dropdown and a "Gratis hinzufügen" (add for free) button. It sits below the free-shipping progress bar in the cart header.

why.text: Free gifts add perceived value: the struck-through price makes the "free" tangible (anchoring), and the progress bar leverages the goal-gradient effect, so shoppers add more to the cart to unlock the reward. Making the gift a one-click action right in the cart reduces friction and increases AOV. Stacking it with the free-shipping bar gives shoppers two clear goals.

how.text: Build a new cart section/block that renders a gift product (chosen in the theme editor or via a collection/metafield) as a distinct, dark-background row at the top of the cart items. Show the original price struck through, a progress bar that fills toward the unlock condition, and a "GRATIS" label with a check icon once unlocked. Include a variant dropdown (only when the gift has variants) and an add button. Adding the gift calls the cart AJAX API with the gift variant at 100% discount (via automatic discount, Shopify Function or a cart-transform/price override). Remove the gift automatically if the cart falls below the threshold. The ticket says the logic should follow Smilodox, but a commenter noted the section is not live there and asked for the exact logic, so the unlock rule (threshold type and value, one gift vs. several) is not confirmed.

items: Unlock threshold (cart value or other rule) — unconfirmed
Progress bar colour (green) and row background (dark grey)
Auto-remove gift when the threshold is no longer met

dependencies.text: Cart drawer with AJAX cart API; a gift product that can be priced at 0 € (automatic discount, Shopify Function or similar); possibly a free-shipping progress bar already in the cart header (shown in the screenshot). Exact unlock logic is not specified in the ticket — the acceptance criteria are cut off after "Creation of a new section called…".

items: Share of carts reaching the unlock threshold

Gift row layout and controls: variant dropdown with highlighted focus state and muted green 'Gratis hinzufügen' button.
